title: Netflix Adds Classroom of the Elite Season 4 in India on August 20
content: Netflix is listing Classroom of the Elite: Year 2 ( Yōkoso Jitsuryoku Shijō Shugi no Kyōshitsu e 4th Season 2-nen Sei Hen 1 Gakki ), the fourth season anime , for release in India on August 20. The fourth season premiered on April 1 with a 90-minute special airing of episodes one to four.
author: ANN

title: New UK Home Editions of Devilman Crybaby and Godzilla Minus One Listed on Amazon
content: Amazon UK is listing a standard UK Blu-ray edition of DEVILMAN crybaby , the 2018 Netflix series directed by Masaaki Yuasa and animated by Science SARU anime, as being released on September 21. The company describes the story: "Devils cannot take form without a living host.
author: ANN

title: Look Back Anime Film Returns to Taiwanese Cinemas on August 27
content: Cai Chang Asia originally opened the film in Taiwan in August 2024. The film opened in Japan in June 2024. Yūmi Kawai and Mizuki Yoshida star in the film. Kawai plays Fujino, a fourth grader who draws four-panel comics in the school newspaper. Yoshida plays Kyomoto, Fujino's classmate who has been skipping school.
author: ANN

title: A New Dawn Anime Film Opens in Indonesia on August 19
content: Indonesian film distributor Feat Pictures announced on Tuesday that it will open ASMIK Ace and French studio Miyu Productions ' A New Dawn ( Hana Rokushō ga Akeru Hi ni ) film in Indonesia on August 19. The film opened in Japan on March 6. The film was originally slated to open last year, but was delayed to this year.
author: ANN

title: Quality Assurance in Another World Manga Enters Hiatus
content: Manga creator Masamichi Sato announced on Kodansha 's Comic Days platform on Saturday that the Quality Assurance in Another World manga will go on an extended hiatus as they focus on recovering from being hospitalized for a hernia. The manga will return at a later date to be announced.
author: ANN

title: 3 Iconic Dragon Ball Z Villains With the Most Memorable Fights
content: In most series centering around battles, villains are the backbone of the stor y. They always push the heroes to their limit and force them to reach new heights of power. When it comes to iconic anime villains, Dragon Ball has more than a few that will go down in history for their most memorable fights.
author: ComicBook

title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Remake Game Streams New English Trailer
content: Nihon Falcom and GungHo Online Entertainment streamed a new English-language trailer for Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter ( Sora no Kiseki the 2nd ), the remake of the original The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky SC game, on Friday.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll’s Hottest New Shonen Anime Just Unveiled Its Own Sasuke & Itachi Duo
content: There are plenty of new anime currently airing on Crunchyroll . However, the one that has undoubtedly been stealing the spotlight is its hottest new shonen anime, Black Torch , which embraces some of the best elements from the greatest shonen series.

title: 5 Years Later, Crunchyroll’s Critically Acclaimed Sports Series Shares First Look At Sequel
content: Original anime series and films often struggle to gain recognition among the audience, even if they’re produced by a renowned studio. Usually, an anime based on a manga or a light novel already has an existing fanbase, making it easier for studios to attract viewers.
